questions.question: What does Ezekiel 32 contain?
options: A song of victory over Babylon
A vision of the restored temple
A lamentation over Pharaoh and Egypt
A list of all the nations to be judged
questions.answer: A lamentation over Pharaoh and Egypt

questions.question: How is Pharaoh described at the start of the lament?
options: Like a peaceful king of peace who never once raised up his sword
Like a lion of the nations, yet really a dragon in the seas
Like a gentle shepherd who softly leads his flock to the water
Like a wise and careful judge who weighs each matter with care
questions.answer: Like a lion of the nations, yet really a dragon in the seas

questions.question: Ezekiel 32 pictures Egypt going down to the pit to join other fallen nations.
You consider yourself a lion of the nations, but you are like a _____ in the seas.
I will cover the heavens and make their stars dark; I will cover the sun with a _____.
